targets.authors: Glikson, E., Cheshin, A., & van Kleef, G. A.
targets.title: The dark side of a smiley: effects of smiling emoticons on virtual first impressions.
targets.evidence_quote:
The present paper reports an independent and better powered (N = 847 vs. N = 85)
replication of Experiment 3 in Glikson et al. (2018).
targets.outcome_quote:
These results suggest that the original study was severely underpowered to
detect any of the three key effects reported in the current
replication and that our study failed to replicate the original findings.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that their study failed to replicate the original findings. This overall verdict governs despite some agreeing main effects; the central formality moderation and moderated mediation were not supported. Exploratory analyses around perceived gender do not add a separate original paper.

reasoning: The complete 13-page published article, including references and appendix, was obtained from the supplied public Google Drive file. Title, both authors and printed DOI match. The article reports new data from 847 participants explicitly retesting Experiment 3. Statcheck recalculation of published p-values is incidental to this replication, not a separate reanalysis of original study data.
